'''Dolla''' was an astronomical object<ref name="GG10" /> located in the [[Dolla system/Legends|Dolla system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of the [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated at the junction of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Nothoiin Corridor]], which connected it to the [[Bavva system/Legends|Bavva system]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] and the [[Eriadu system/Legends|Eriadu system]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], and the [[Anturi Reach]], which linked it to the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector's]] [[Yetoom system/Legends|Yetoom system]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Dolla was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], and the celestial body was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Dolla served as a major [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] staging area of the Outer Rim Territories during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="GG10" /> and at some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which corresponds to a [[Time/Legends|time]] period which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' sets between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. ''Galaxy Guide 10'' also establishes that [[Jedselk]] was promoted to [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Dolla at least two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the sourcebook's setting and after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the latter of which occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], per ''The New Essential Chronology''. Therefore, Jedselk must have become governor of Dolla at some point between 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Planetary Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Jedselk]] of the<ref name="GG10" /> [[Jjannex sector/Legends|Jjannex sector]]<ref name="EAOC Sellasas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sellasas system/Legends|Sellasas system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sellasas]] was promoted to the [[Governor/Legends|governorship]] of Dolla.<ref name="GG10" /> The population of the Dolla [[Star system/Legends|system]] around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one and ten million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dolla was first mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', which was authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Dolla system, and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
